title: The tech and the dog
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The print shop has no rule about dogs because nobody thought of it. The tech and the dog regard each other across the counter. The tech runs the digest with the dog in it for the first time. Panel two.

panels.composition: The print shop. BARNABY on the counter — Wood lifted him. The TECH looking at him. WOOD.

image.prompt: a small scruffy dog sitting on a print shop counter while a technician in an apron regards it and a young man stands by, black and white, no words
a print technician's face close to a small dog's face across a counter, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A strip going under the copier lid: a dog under a table, panel two. The green light.

image.prompt: close on a comic strip going under a photocopier lid, a small dog visible in its second panel, green light sweeping, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copies coming out. The dog on the counter watching them stack. Himself, two hundred times, warm.

image.prompt: a small dog on a counter watching photocopies stack in a copier's tray, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The dog in the digest, first. Panel two, of course.
